checks.name: A fresh visitor has no app identity and is not redirected to a developer dashboard
Upcoming NFL games load from published sources without sign-in or a CSV upload
Automatic trusted-data preparation and 10,000 coherent complete games produce player and game distributions
A repeated Analyze Game action reuses the same fresh persisted result
Public analysis explanation contains sources and correctly identifies AI versus evidence-only generation
Personal finances, saved forecasts, private simulations and conversation history remain protected
Another identity-free request reopens the saved shared research without a personal session

limitations: Acceptance verifies actual data retrieval, football mechanics, public caching and private-record boundaries; it does not prove calibration or market advantage.
Unavailable injury and price data must remain labeled unavailable. Evidence-only text is not a live OpenAI response.
Physical Safari Add to Home Screen installation is not performed by this script.
